title: Read-only view
description:
Write `readOnly(obj)` that returns a Proxy over `obj` which allows reading but refuses every change:

- Reading properties works as normal.
- Setting a property throws a `TypeError` whose message contains the property name.
- Deleting a property throws a `TypeError` too.
- The original object can still be changed directly, and the proxy shows those changes.
hints: Two traps are enough: `set` and `deleteProperty`, each throwing. There is no `get` trap, so reads go to the target unchanged.
